summary.text: Kilton Webb is a Democratic state representative and electrician who has represented Maine House District 98 since December 2024 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Webb graduated from Maranacook High School.
His career experience includes working as an electrician, and he has been affiliated with the International Brotherhood of Electrical Workers Local 567.
Webb assumed office in the Maine House on December 3, 2024, succeeding Joseph Galletta, and advanced from the Democratic primary on June 9, 2026.
